title: Stir Fry with Umami Flavor
description: A simple and flavorful stir fry dish made with umami sauce, ginger, and stir-fried vegetables, served with a side of French bread.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add onion and bell peppers and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add snow peas and cook for 1-2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together umami sauce, soy sauce, and honey.
Pour the sauce over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve over French bread, topped with sesame seeds if desired.
Cook the French bread by toasting it in the oven for 2-3 minutes or until crispy.
